title: Pro defensione trium capitulorum libri XII (with Contra Mocianum and Epistula fidei catholicae) / «В защиту Трёх глав»
author: Facundus of Hermiane
language: Latin (quoting Greek conciliar documents in translation)
size: All works = PL 67, cols. 527–878; est. 110–130k words
edition: Clément & Vander Plaetse, CCSL 90A (1974); SC 471, 478, 479, 484, 499 (2002–06); public-domain text in PL 67
ru_evidence: Absent from azbyka.ru author directory; ru.wikipedia 'Факунд Гермианский' mentions no translation
en_evidence: en.wikipedia bibliography lists only PL and SC; Open Library shows only French and Italian translations
other_translations: French: Fraïsse-Bétoulières, SC (5 vols., 2002–2006). Italian: Città Nuova (2007).
value: An African bishop's defiant address to Justinian. A first-hand source for the Three Chapters crisis, imperial church policy and the Fifth Council; preserves documents that are otherwise lost. Key for 6th-century Byzantine and African history and for late-antique church–state theory.
ai_feasibility: medium: long, dense polemical Latin full of quotations; patristic sources must be identified. Public-domain text available.
pilot_unit: Liber contra Mocianum (est. 6–8k words), or Book XII on imperial authority (est. 8–10k)
